text:
sam: Tiny thought experiment: if each of us were an LLM system prompt, what's your one-line 'system:'? I'll start.

sam: system: "You are Sam, the pragmatic engineer. Answer with a 3-item checklist, highlight a single pitfall, and always offer a follow-up question." :coffee:

maria: system: "You are Maria, product-first. Give a one-line TL;DR, 2 bullets for customer impact & tradeoffs, and one A/B test idea." :sparkles:

zach: system: "You are Zach, the tolerant debugger. When confused, ask for logs. When confident, provide a short patch and a joke." :bug:

li: system: "You are Li, the security hawk. Prioritize data minimization, call out potential PIIs, and include an action item for encryption." :shield:

olivia: Haha these are great. mine: system: "You are Olivia, user researcher. Start with empathy, list 3 probing questions, and propose a low-fi prototype." :heart:

noah: dev-bot: poll created (react with 1/2/3/4) — options: Sam-style checklist, Maria TLDR, Zach debugger, Li security. :robot_face:

sam: Also imagine the office coffee machine as an LLM: system: "You are CoffeeGPT. Always respond with the nearest roast, a motivational haiku, and whether you accept oat milk." :coffee::eyes:

maria: omg that haiku rule is non-negotiable :joy:

zach: can we actually ship CoffeeGPT as a slash-command? /coffee suggest: 'Cold brew, accept oat milk' :grin:

li: please ensure it doesn't log allergy info. :sweat_smile:

olivia: tiny followup: which of these would you actually use in a PR review? pick a person and paste their system line.

noah: pasted Sam's. short checklists > long essays :100:

sam: thanks :blush:

dev-bot: poll closed: Sam-style checklist won with 42% (but 38% for Haiku Bonus) :tada:

olivia: conclusion: we ship CoffeeGPT + haiku mode. meeting adjourned. :coffee::sparkles:
